name: Mind Evolution
org: Google DeepMind, University of California, San Diego
one_liner: Island-model evolutionary search in natural language paired with programmatic constraint evaluators to solve multi-constraint planning tasks.

loop.proposes: An LLM generates, recombines, and refines candidate travel plans, schedules, and cipher solutions across parallel evolutionary islands.
loop.judged_by: A programmatic evaluator scores each plan and returns textual feedback on violated constraints.
loop.steers: Boltzmann tournament selection, island migration, and elitism propagate high-scoring plans into the next generation.

headline_result: Solved >95% of TravelPlanner and Natural Plan multi-constraint benchmarks with Gemini 1.5 Flash, surpassing Best-of-N and sequential Reflexion by wide margins.
caveat: Requires a programmatic constraint evaluator for the target planning domain to score candidate solutions accurately.
beyond_harness_note: A multi-island genetic algorithm with programmatic constraint evaluators drives selection, crossover, and migration across generations.
algorithmic_authority: Programmatic constraint checker and island genetic algorithm

verification.notes: Checked against Lee et al., arXiv:2501.09891.
